messages.HTML 报告链接需要配置可访问的站点地址；HTML 邮件附件需邮件工作流支持附: HTML report links require an accessible site address. HTML email attachments require attachment mapping in the email workflow.
messages.HTML 附件支持设置必须为布尔值。: HTML attachment support must be enabled or disabled with a boolean value.
messages.请先在现有 Power Automate 邮件工作流中将 attachments: First map the attachments array's Name and ContentBytes fields to email attachments in your existing Power Automate email workflow. Then confirm HTML attachment support in the delivery settings.
messages.HTML 附件仅支持邮件发送；Teams 请使用正文和链接。: HTML attachments are supported for email only. Use message body and links for Teams.
messages.HTML 报告包含无效数值，请先处理报告字段。: The HTML report contains invalid numbers. Correct the report fields first.
messages.HTML 报告包含无法显示的数据。: The HTML report contains data that cannot be displayed.
messages.来源链接显示数量无效。: The source link display limit is invalid.
messages.来源链接格式无效。: The source link format is invalid.
messages.来源链接无效，无法生成 HTML 报告。: A source link is invalid. The HTML report could not be generated.
messages.HTML 报告超出行列范围，请缩小报告或改用链接发送。: The HTML report exceeds the row or column limit. Reduce the report size or send a link instead.
messages.报告下载链接无效，无法生成 HTML 报告。: The report download link is invalid. The HTML report could not be generated.
messages.HTML 报告包含无效文字编码。: The HTML report contains invalid text encoding.
messages.HTML 报告超过 1 MB，请减少字段或日期范围，或改用链接发送；未截断报告。: The HTML report exceeds 1 MB. Reduce the fields or date range, or send a link instead. The report has not been truncated.
messages.HTML 附件文件名无效。: The HTML attachment filename is invalid.
messages.HTML 附件内容无效。: The HTML attachment content is invalid.
messages.HTML 附件为空或超过 1 MB，请改用链接发送。: The HTML attachment is empty or exceeds 1 MB. Send a link instead.
messages.以 HTML 附件发送 Digest: Send Digest as an HTML Attachment
messages.HTML 文件作为邮件附件发送，需要邮件工作流支持附件映射。: Send the HTML file as an email attachment. The email workflow must map attachments.
messages.请选择有效的 Digest 邮件格式。: Select a valid digest email format.
messages.邮件工作流尚未确认附件映射；完成配置后才能发送 HTML 附件。: The email workflow's attachment mapping is not confirmed. Complete the mapping before sending HTML attachments.
messages.仅在已将请求中的 attachments 数组映射到邮件操作的附件后勾选；每项: Select only after mapping the request's attachments array to the email action's attachments. Each Name is the attachment filename; ContentBytes is the Base64 file content. Format: attachments: [{Name, ContentBytes}]. Existing Excel fields can stay in place.
messages.当前邮件工作流尚未确认支持 HTML 附件；发送前请升级工作流并确认附件支持。: This email workflow has not been confirmed to support HTML attachments. Update its attachment mapping and confirm support before sending.
messages.EnGenie Digest 来源链接开关必须为布尔值。: EnGenie Digest source links must be enabled or disabled with a boolean value.
messages.EnGenie Digest 邮件格式仅支持正文或 HTML 附件。: EnGenie Digest email format must be message body or an HTML attachment.
messages.EnGenie Digest 邮件格式仅支持正文、HTML 链接或 HTML 附: EnGenie Digest presentation must be digest body, an HTML report link, or an HTML email attachment.
messages.EnGenie Digest 配置无效。: The EnGenie Digest configuration is invalid.
messages.EnGenie Digest 开关必须为布尔值。: EnGenie Digest must be enabled or disabled with a boolean value.
messages.EnGenie Digest 要求不能超过 2000 字符。: EnGenie Digest instructions must be 2,000 characters or fewer.
messages.EnGenie Digest 语言仅支持 English 或简体中文。: EnGenie Digest supports English or Simplified Chinese only.
messages.EnGenie Digest 需要有效且不重复的报告字段。: EnGenie Digest requires valid, unique report fields.
messages.EnGenie Digest 分组需引用最多两个不重复的报告输出字段。: EnGenie Digest grouping supports up to two unique fields from the report output.
messages.EnGenie Digest 最多支持 12 个汇总指标。: EnGenie Digest supports up to 12 summary metrics.
messages.EnGenie Digest 汇总指标格式无效。: An EnGenie Digest summary metric has an invalid format.
messages.EnGenie Digest 汇总需使用有效运算和报告输出字段。: EnGenie Digest metrics must use valid operations and report output fields.
messages.EnGenie Digest 指标名称需有效且不重复，最多 80 字符。: EnGenie Digest metric names must be valid, unique, and no longer than 80 characters.
messages.EnGenie Digest 数据包含无法汇总的值。: The EnGenie Digest data contains values that cannot be aggregated.
messages.EnGenie Digest 报告行格式无效。: An EnGenie Digest report row has an invalid format.
messages.EnGenie Digest 分组值过长，请选择更短的分类字段。: An EnGenie Digest group value is too long. Choose a shorter category field.
messages.EnGenie Digest 数据过多，请减少报告字段或分组指标。: There is too much data for EnGenie Digest. Reduce the report fields or grouping metrics.
messages.EnGenie Digest 生成失败或超时，本次未发送；请检查模型或调整摘要要: EnGenie Digest failed or timed out. Nothing was sent. Check the model or adjust the digest instructions.
messages.EnGenie Digest 没有可汇总的数据，本次未生成摘要。: There is no data to aggregate. No EnGenie Digest was generated.
messages.EnGenie Digest 无法使用当前回答模型，请检查站点模型设置。: EnGenie Digest cannot use the current model. Check the site model settings.
messages.EnGenie 摘要生成失败，本次未发送。: EnGenie Digest generation failed. Nothing was sent.
messages.EnGenie 摘要设置已保存；发送计划保持不变。: EnGenie Digest settings saved. The delivery schedule is unchanged.
messages.自动概述报告数据并附上汇总数字。: Summarize the report data and include aggregated figures.
messages.Digest 要求不能超过 2000 字符。: Digest instructions must be 2,000 characters or fewer.
messages.在邮件或 Teams 正文中加入 EnGenie 摘要和汇总数字。: Include an EnGenie summary and aggregated figures in the email or Teams message.
messages.为邮件或 Teams 添加 EnGenie 摘要和汇总数字。: Add an EnGenie summary and aggregated figures to email or Teams.
messages.通过 EnGenie 对话设置分组和自定义统计；此处保留已有设置。: Set grouping and custom metrics through EnGenie chat. Existing settings are preserved here.
messages.发送时包含简要总结和汇总数字。: Include a concise summary and aggregated figures when sending.
messages.当前数据未满足触发条件；本次不生成或发送摘要。: The trigger condition is not met. No digest is generated or sent for this check.
messages.当前没有可用于摘要的数据，本次未发送。: There is no data to summarize. Nothing was sent.
messages.本次未生成摘要。: No digest was generated for this preview.
messages.摘要预览未完成。: The digest preview did not complete.
messages.摘要将在报告发送前生成。可通过 EnGenie 对话预览和调整。: The digest will be generated before sending. Preview and adjust it through EnGenie chat.
messages.分组预览最多展示 20 组；总计覆盖全部报告结果。: Preview up to 20 groups. Totals cover the full report output.
messages.请先启用 EnGenie Digest 并生成预览。: Enable EnGenie Digest and generate a preview first.
messages.摘要预览尚未生成，请返回 EnGenie 重新预览。: The digest preview has not been generated. Return to EnGenie and generate it again.
messages.报告数据已变化，请重新生成摘要预览。: The report data has changed. Generate a new digest preview.
messages.HTML 报告图表必须为最多 8 个配置的列表。: HTML report charts must be a list of up to 8 configurations.
messages.HTML 图表需要有效的报告输出字段。: HTML charts require valid report output fields.
messages.HTML 图表仅接受字段与样式配置，不能包含脚本或直接数据。: HTML charts accept field and style settings only. Scripts and inline data are not allowed.
messages.HTML 图表类型或标题无效。: The HTML chart type or title is invalid.
messages.HTML 图表横轴必须引用实际报告输出字段。: The HTML chart's horizontal axis must reference an actual report output field.
messages.每个 HTML 图表需包含 1 至 6 个数据系列。: Each HTML chart requires 1 to 6 data series.
messages.饼图需一个系列，组合图至少需两个系列。: Pie charts require one series. Combo charts require at least two series.
messages.HTML 图表系列配置无效。: The HTML chart series configuration is invalid.
messages.HTML 图表系列需使用有效运算和报告输出字段。: HTML chart series must use valid operations and report output fields.
messages.饼图占比仅支持数量或合计，请将平均值与极值改用柱状或折线图。: Pie chart proportions support counts or sums only. Use bar or line charts for averages, minimums, and maximums.
messages.HTML 图表系列名称需为最多 80 字符的文本。: HTML chart series names must be text of up to 80 characters.
messages.HTML 组合图系列仅支持 line/bar 和 left/right 坐标轴。: HTML combo chart series support line/bar types and left/right axes only.
messages.系列类型与右侧坐标轴仅用于组合图。: Series types and the right axis are only available for combo charts.
messages.组合图需同时包含柱状和折线系列。: Combo charts must include both bar and line series.
messages.HTML 图表需使用有效排序及 1 至 100 个显示分组。: HTML charts require a valid sort order and 1 to 100 displayed groups.
messages.HTML 图表样式选项无效，不能包含自定义代码。: The HTML chart style options are invalid. Custom code is not allowed.
messages.HTML 图表样式开关必须为布尔值。: HTML chart style toggles must be boolean values.
messages.HTML 图表坐标轴名称不能超过 80 字符。: HTML chart axis names must be 80 characters or fewer.
messages.水平布局仅支持柱状图，堆叠仅支持柱状或组合图。: Horizontal layout is available for bar charts only. Stacking is available for bar or combo charts only.
messages.HTML 图表数值超出可绘制范围。: An HTML chart value is outside the drawable range.
messages.HTML 图表仅接受最多 5000 行有效报告结果。: HTML charts accept up to 5,000 valid report output rows.
messages.HTML 图表分组值过长，请选择更短的分类字段。: An HTML chart group value is too long. Choose a shorter category field.
messages.饼图不能包含负值，请改用柱状图或折线图。: Pie charts cannot contain negative values. Use a bar or line chart instead.
messages.散点图横轴需为有效数值，请选择数值字段。: The scatter chart's horizontal axis requires valid numbers. Choose a numeric field.

patterns.source: EnGenie Digest 指标「{label}」包含未解析的非数值，请先在报告中配置数值转换。
patterns.target: EnGenie Digest metric “{label}” contains unparsed non-numeric values. Configure numeric conversion in the report first.

patterns.source: HTML 图表数值字段「{field}」含无法转换的值，请先配置报告转换。
patterns.target: HTML chart numeric field “{field}” contains values that could not be converted. Configure a report conversion first.

englishSource.The calculation references an unavailabl: 计算引用了不可用的字段。请先取消隐藏所需字段。
englishSource.The report references an unavailable fie: 报告引用了不可用的字段。请取消隐藏所需字段或更新报告。
